text:
Mara K: Idea: pilot an 'Action Journal' to track PM follow-ups per incident. One lightweight doc per incident with owner, due date, status, recurrence flag, postmortem link, and IC rotation notes. Run for 8 weeks with a 15-min weekly pulse. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Jordan L: Love it. Can we auto-create entries from the postmortem close so owners don't retype?

Samir: +1. Draft template below; can wire to GH issues or a Google Doc from the closure step.

Samir: ```
Action Journal entry:
- Incident ID:
- Postmortem link:
- Owner: @
- Due: YYYY-MM-DD
- Priority: P0/P1/P2
- Status: open/in-progress/blocked/closed
- Recurrence flag: none/recurring/suspected-pattern
- Root cause (1 line):
- Mitigation tasks: [task 1] [task 2]
- IC notes: rotation suggestions, handoff items
- Follow-up check dates: weekly dates (auto-schedule)
```

Khalid: Prefer GH issues in a dedicated repo for assignees, labels, PR linking, reminders. Add label "recurring-pattern". Sheets ok for quick pilots but issues scale.

ops-bot: reminder: Action Journal template posted in #eng-oncall (https://go.redwood.example/action-journal-template) :bell:

Rowan: For IC rotation: propose a monthly rotation calendar. Journal should flag keep/rotate for next IC to avoid knowledge bottlenecks.

Elena: Comms cadence proposal:
- T+0: incident post in #incidents + triage in #eng-oncall
- T+1h: short status update
- T+24h: summary + action journal link (owners/due dates/recurrence)
- T+72h: first remediation progress update
- Weekly: pulse check until actions closed/downgraded

Mara K: Make the T+24h message include owners/due dates/recurrence so product/support can triage resource needs.

Jordan L: I'll set up the GH repo and a tiny GH Action to auto-create issues from postmortem close. I'll add a bot to ping owners 48h before due.

Samir: I'll own the journal template and weekly pulse checklist.

Khalid: I'll add labels and a small dashboard for recurring incidents (heatmap + top 5 routes).

Rowan: I'll update the IC rotation calendar and add monthly sign-ups to the handbook.

Mara K: Can we start the pilot next Monday for 8 weeks? Acceptance: owners assigned within 48h, >80% actions have due dates, weekly pulse scheduled.

Jordan L: Good with me.

Samir: Good to go.

Khalid: 👍

Elena: :+1:

Mara K: I'll post kickoff + template tomorrow. Ping me if you want to join the pilot.
